name: presplit-wall
description: Chapter 5: Presplit row plus production drill holes for zero back-break wall control

steps.description: Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — #553's automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole. #553 also shrunk this file's plan: the original 9-hole production grid + 5-hole presplit row (14 holes total, depth 10-12m) is a full shift's work for a single driller/drill_rig now that drilling takes real time -- sandbox-measured, that full pattern pushes the crew into a genuine worker_revolt (WorkerRevolt.ts: wellBeing pinned at 0 for REVOLT_TICKS=120) around tick 400, regardless of cash on hand or a nearby living_quarters, since one employee cannot both drill nonstop and rest enough. Shrunk to a 2x2 production grid (4 holes) plus a 3-hole presplit row (7 holes total) -- still proves the same pattern (a presplit row alongside production holes, charged with a different product), just at a workload one driller can actually finish. Cash bumped to $100,000 (from $50,000) for headroom through the ~245-tick wait (no income anywhere in this file).

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:5 depth:12 start:20,20
steps.description: Production grid drilled first (Finding #8: drill_plan grid replaces the whole plan and resets hole ids to H1 — see finding log — so the production grid must land before anything else, not after). The spacing stepper defaults to 3m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M) and depth to 6m (DEFAULT_DEPTH_M, Drill.ts); two increment clicks on spacing (3->5) and six on depth (6->12) before dragging the (20,20)-(25,25) rectangle (5x5) so it computes the declared 2x2 instead of the default-spacing 2x2-at-wrong-depth (issue #479 follow-up, Finding #4). #553: shrunk from 3x3 (9 holes) — see the opening step's description.

expect.note: 2 rows x 2 cols = 4 holes ordered (ghosts), none drilled yet (#553) — the presplit row is added next, appended without wiping this grid (drill_plan add, unlike drill_plan grid)

steps.description: First presplit-row hole: the add-hole tool (data-action="add-hole-tool", Drill.ts) — a real UI control distinct from the rect grid tool, point-shaped placement. Its depth stepper shares Drill.ts's single gridDepth field with the grid tool above, still sitting at 12m from the production grid; two decrement clicks bring it to the presplit row's declared 10m before placing this and every hole after it (the field persists across arm/disarm, Finding #4's class again).

Third and last presplit-row hole (#553: shrunk from 5 to 3 — see the opening step's description) — the presplit line now runs (10,20)-(16,20), parallel to and clear of the production grid at (20,20)-(25,25).

#553: drain the ordered plan — every hole must actually land before per-hole charging below (the presplit row needs a different product from the production holes). Sandbox-measured landing at tick 244.

expect.note: All 7 holes have landed — none lost, none left ordered forever.

Charge All reaches every hole that exists by this point — all 7, production and presplit alike, with boomite. The presplit row's real explosive is applied next, one hole at a time, overwriting these 3 with pop_rock — chargedCount stays 7 throughout, only the per-hole explosiveId changes

steps.description: #554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

Per-hole charging is a real control now (gap G3, ChargeHoleList.ts): the Charge step renders a "Per Hole" section, one row per hole keyed by data-hole, each with its own commit button at [data-hole="<id>"] [data-action="charge-hole"]. That button dispatches `charge hole:<id> explosive:<selected> amount:<amount>kg stemming:<stemming>m` from the panel's current product card / amount / stemming values (ChargeStep.chargeHole, Charge.ts) — the same three values Charge All reads, so the steppers have to be driven to the declared numbers first. The presplit line is exactly the case per-hole charging exists for: holes that must carry a different product from the production holes Charge All just loaded. Clicking the pop_rock product card also clamps the amount stepper into pop_rock's own [0.5, 3]kg range (ChargeStep.clampAmount), taking it 5 -> 3kg; 1 further decrement reaches the declared 2kg, and 5 stemming increments take 2.0 -> 3.0m. The Charge All step above pinned the panel to [data-step="2"], so the Per Hole rows stay visible for all three. Amount steps by 1kg (data-field="amount", clamped to the selected product's [minChargeKg, maxChargeKg]); stemming steps by 0.2m with a 0.5m floor (data-field="stemming", Charge.ts adjustStemming). Both are plain instance fields on ChargeStep with no reset path, so they carry over from the previous charge step in the same page session — asserted before each commit rather than assumed. Finding #7 class: the file previously charged bare-numeric hole:1..hole:5 with a fictional explosive:presplit id that does not exist in ExplosiveCatalog.ts (8 real products, none named presplit) — every charge silently failed on BOTH counts and chargedCount for these holes stayed 0 through this file's entire history. Fixed by using the real hole id (H5, drill_plan add's own numbering, continuing from the production grid's H1-H4 — #553 shrunk the production grid from H1-H9) and pop_rock — the catalog's lowest-energy, lowest-projection-risk, lowest-vibration product, the real product that matches a presplit line's job.

expect.note: chargedCount does not move — Charge All had already loaded all 7 holes with boomite; what changes here is H5's explosiveId/amount/stemming

steps.description: #554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

Same product and same stepper values as H5 — a player selects the product once and walks the presplit rows, so this step is one click on H6's own [data-action="charge-hole"], with the panel state asserted first.
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

Same product and same stepper values as the row before it — a player selects the product once and walks the presplit rows, so this step is one click on H7's own [data-action="charge-hole"], with the panel state asserted first.

expect.note: all 3 presplit holes now carry pop_rock alongside the 4 production holes' boomite

steps.description: #554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero — all 7 holes (both explosives) detonate together in one plan, proving the presplit row and production grid actually coexist now (Finding #8), unlike every previous run of this file
